en: Old black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a riverside settlement in a wooded valley. In the foreground are several ornate late‑19th‑century villas with steep, tiled roofs and one small tower or spire. A narrow road or path runs between the houses and the river. On the river itself there is a rectangular fenced structure or floating platform, possibly a bathing area or small harbor installation. In the background are additional houses and farm fields, with a forested hill rising beyond. The overall scene is tranquil and rural. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image.
